support.title: Support this app
support.heading: Free, and staying that way.
paragraphs: Nothing here is locked, timed, or nagged about, and nothing changes if you skip this page. It is here because people asked where to send something.
If the app saved you an evening of editing config files, that is already the nicest outcome.
support.footnote: Thank you either way. Enjoy the games.

guide.title: Doing this in the right order

steps.title: Pick your game
steps.body: Choose it from the list at the top. If it is not there, pick Custom and point the app at the folder yourself.

steps.title: Read the game info
steps.body: Open Game info for the game you picked. Some games hide behind a codename, keep their settings in an odd folder, or need something else known first. It takes a moment and can save you the whole rest of this.

steps.title: Look at the folder
steps.body: The path under WRITES TO is where the file goes. Check it has your game's name or its codename in it. If it looks wrong, use Change folder. Open folder shows it in Explorer.

steps.title: Start the game once first
steps.body: The game has to have run at least once, or there is nothing to back up and nothing to tune. Better still: play for a few minutes and set the in-game graphics options the way you want them. Those settings are the ground this builds on.

steps.title: Take the origin backup
steps.body: This is not optional and the app will not write anything until it exists. It records the factory state, once, so there is always a way back. You are asked two questions first; answer them honestly, because nobody else can know.

steps.title: Leave it on Recommended
steps.body: Recommended is the preset most people should use. Quality assumes a strong GPU. Performance trades looks for frame rate. If you are not sure, you want Recommended.

steps.title: Check Your setup
steps.body: This tab is about you, not about the game: your monitor, your display, whether motion blur bothers you. Go through it once. Anything you set here is used whichever preset you chose.

steps.title: Add your own lines last
steps.body: Anything you type in the custom box is written at the very end of the file, after everything the app generates, and is kept every time the file is rebuilt. In an ini file the last line wins, so this is also how you overrule anything above it.

catalog._comment: Generated by tools/build_catalog.py from data/_commands.json and data/_values.json. Do not edit by hand.

conditions.preference: Personal taste; nothing about your hardware decides it.
conditions.vrs-gpu: Needs a GPU that supports Variable Rate Shading.
conditions.hdr-display: Needs an HDR display with HDR enabled in Windows.
conditions.laptop: Only matters on a battery-powered laptop.
conditions.game-feature: Only matters if the game actually uses this feature.

categories.title: Anti-Aliasing & Upscaling
categories.summary: How jagged edges are smoothed and how the image is upscaled, including TSR — UE5's default upscaler.

entries.name: r.PostProcessAAQuality
entries.rationale: Stock and documented, range 0-6. Value 4 is a sensible general AA-quality option and is part of Epic's scalability guidance.

entries.name: r.AntiAliasingMethod
entries.rationale: Current stock selector, but 2 forces legacy TAA over UE5's current TSR default (4). It can conflict with modern upscaler integrations. Valid only as an explicit AA-mode choice.

entries.name: r.TemporalAA.Upsampling
entries.rationale: Current stock CVar and default 1. Relevant only when intentionally configuring TAAU or a third-party temporal upscaler; otherwise redundant.

entries.name: r.TemporalAACatmullRom
entries.rationale: Current stock TAA CVar, but 0 is already its documented default. Omit it so the game/project inherits normally.

entries.name: r.TemporalAACurrentFrameWeight
entries.rationale: Current stock TAA CVar; current documented default is 0.04. Higher weight can reduce blur/ghosting but exposes more jitter/flicker. Strong TAA-only tradeoff.

entries.name: r.TemporalAAFilterSize
entries.rationale: Current stock TAA CVar; default 1. Lower is sharper but more aliased. TAA-only user preference, not a universal quality improvement.

entries.name: r.TemporalAASamples
entries.rationale: Current stock CVar, but 8 is already the documented default. Omit it so the game/project inherits normally.

entries.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering
entries.rationale: Real stock TSR heuristic. Epic drives it through AA scalability tiers; forcing it can reduce moire/flicker but can ghost animated materials or geometry with missing/bad motion vectors.

entries.name: r.TSR.ShadingRejection.Flickering.Period
entries.rationale: Real stock TSR control, but defaults changed across UE5 revisions. A longer period favors stability and can increase ghosting. TSR-version/content tuning, never a universal override.

categories.title: Post-Processing & Lens Effects
categories.summary: Lens-style image effects: film grain, chromatic aberration (colour fringing), depth of field, bloom, lens flares and image sharpening.

entries.name: r.FilmGrain
entries.rationale: Source state: commented/inert under [SystemSettings]. Valid broad optional Disable Film Grain control. Value 0 disables stock UE film grain but cannot remove grain from a custom post-process material.

entries.name: r.SceneColorFringeQuality
entries.rationale: Current stock CVar. 0 disables stock chromatic aberration and avoids its sample cost. Good optional "Disable Chromatic Aberration" setting. It cannot disable a game's custom post-process material.

entries.name: r.Bloom.AsyncCompute
entries.rationale: Current stock CVar; 1 is already default. It only concerns FFT/convolution bloom and remains gated by renderer/platform support. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.DepthOfFieldQuality
entries.rationale: Source state: commented/inert under [SystemSettings]. Valid Disable Depth of Field preference and performance toggle, but it can undermine gameplay focus, cameras and cinematics.

entries.name: r.LensFlareQuality
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid lens-flare quality control; 2 is the current default/good quality level.

entries.name: r.Tonemapper.Sharpen
entries.rationale: Current stock desktop CVar; default -1 inherits. 1.5 is aggressive and can add halos/noise, especially with temporal upscalers. Prefer an adjustable control; do not force it universally. Not supported by the mobile tonemapper.

categories.title: Motion Blur
categories.summary: How much motion blur the game applies.

entries.name: r.MotionBlur.Amount
entries.rationale: Stock CVar; default -1 inherits authored post-process settings. 0.25 globally forces reduced blur, including cutscenes. Suitable only for an opt-in reduced motion-blur control.

entries.name: r.MotionBlur.Max
entries.rationale: Stock CVar; default -1 inherits. The value is percent of screen width, so 0.40 is a strong 0.4% cap that can substantially change the intended look.

entries.name: r.MotionBlur.Scale
entries.rationale: Real stock CVar, but 1 is its documented default/no-scaling value. Omit the line and let the game inherit that behavior.

entries.name: r.MotionBlurQuality
entries.rationale: Real stock CVar; 0=off through 4=very high. Value 4 is maximum quality with extra cost and is irrelevant when blur is disabled. Use only in a named quality option, not as a universal default.

categories.title: Lumen Lighting & Reflections
categories.summary: Lumen — UE5's lighting and reflections system; how detailed and accurate indirect light and reflections are.

entries.name: r.Lumen.DiffuseIndirect.AsyncCompute
entries.rationale: Valid current Lumen control and already default 1 where supported. Omit and let the renderer/platform select the applicable path.

entries.name: r.Lumen.DiffuseIndirect.SSAO
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen control, default 0. It enables SSAO when ShortRangeAO is disabled, changing both GPU cost and the contact-occlusion look.

entries.name: r.Lumen.RadianceCache.SupersampleDistanceFromCamera
entries.rationale: Source state: commented/inert under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen radiance-cache control; 2000 is the current default, so the source correctly leaves it commented.

entries.name: r.Lumen.Reflections.DownsampleFactor
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen reflection control; full-resolution factor 1 is the current constructor default.

entries.name: r.Lumen.Reflections.RadianceCache
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0, and explicitly experimental/content-sensitive. It can shorten rough-reflection rays by reusing cached distant lighting, with potential fidelity/stability tradeoffs. Tested Lumen-reflections profile only.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.IrradianceFormat
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen Screen Probe Gather format control; 0 is the current default.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.MaxRoughnessToEvaluateRoughSpecularForFoliage
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid scalability-driven Lumen foliage threshold. Values vary by reflection quality; forcing 0.8 locks the high-quality rough-specular workload across presets.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.NumProbesToTraceBudget
entries.rationale: Source state: commented/inert under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen probe-update budget, but the current constructor default is 100 and scalability can override it. Locking 300 improves responsiveness at additional GPU cost.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.RadianceCache.ProbeResolution
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen radiance-cache control; 32 is the current default probe resolution and ray count already scales with its square.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen control; Screen Probe Gather screen traces already default to 1.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenTraces.HZBTraversal.FullResDepth
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen HZB traversal control; full-resolution depth already defaults to 1.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ShortRangeAO
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen control, default 1. Disabling ShortRangeAO saves full-resolution work but removes high-frequency contact occlusion.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.StochasticInterpolation
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Uses one stochastic sample instead of four bilinear samples: potentially cheaper, but noisier and less stable. Lumen-specific A/B test.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TemporalFilterProbes
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Can reduce probe noise but adds temporal response delay and possible ghosting. Content-specific Lumen option.

entries.name: r.Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.TracingOctahedronResolution
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen quality control; current normal default is 8. Raising octahedron resolution to 16 greatly increases traces per probe and GPU cost.

entries.name: r.Lumen.TraceMeshSDFs
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen software-tracing control, default 0. Mesh SDF tracing can improve off-screen coverage but is costly in dense or overlapping scenes.

entries.name: r.Lumen.TraceMeshSDFs.Allow
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen permission gate; allowing Mesh SDF tracing already defaults to 1 and does not itself force the path.

entries.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.FrontLayer.Allow
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen front-layer translucency permission gate; Allow already defaults to 1.

entries.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyReflections.FrontLayer.Enable
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen front-layer translucency switch, default 0. It improves translucent reflections at a feature- and content-specific GPU cost.

entries.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.RadianceCache.NumProbesToTraceBudget
entries.rationale: Source state: commented/inert under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen translucency radiance-cache budget; 200 probes is the current default.

entries.name: r.Lumen.TranslucencyVolume.TraceFromVolume
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen translucency control; tracing from the volume already defaults to 1.

entries.name: r.LumenScene.DirectLighting.OffscreenShadowing.TraceMeshSDFs
entries.rationale: Valid, default 1. Uses lower-resolution Global SDF rather than Mesh SDFs for offscreen shadows: faster but less accurate, and relevant to software Lumen.

entries.name: r.LumenScene.Lighting.AsyncCompute
entries.rationale: Valid and already current default 1 where possible. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.LumenScene.ParallelUpdate
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default. Omit and inherit.

categories.title: Hardware Ray Tracing
categories.summary: Hardware ray tracing — more accurate reflections, shadows and lighting on GPUs that support it, including Lumen's ray-traced mode.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Culling.Angle
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock ray-tracing culling control; 1 degree is the current documented default.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Culling.Radius
entries.rationale: Source state: commented/inert under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock ray-tracing culling radius. Current registry help reports 30000 cm while Epic's current performance guide still says 10000 cm; do not force it universally while the primary guidance conflicts.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Enable
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid experimental runtime ray-tracing switch; current default is 1. Project support and r.RayTracing.EnableOnDemand still gate whether runtime switching can work.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Geometry.Cable
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock ray-tracing geometry control; Cable inclusion already defaults to 1.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Geometry.GeometryCache
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock ray-tracing geometry control; Geometry Cache inclusion already defaults to 1.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Geometry.HierarchicalInstancedStaticMesh
entries.rationale: Source state: commented/inert under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock ray-tracing geometry control; HISM inclusion already defaults to 1, so leaving this candidate commented is correct.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Geometry.Landscape.DetectTextureStreaming
entries.rationale: Source state: commented/inert under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock Landscape ray-tracing control; the current reference value is already 1 and it only matters to the applicable Landscape update path.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Geometry.SkeletalMeshes
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock ray-tracing geometry control; Skeletal Mesh inclusion already defaults to 1.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Geometry.SplineMeshes
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock ray-tracing geometry control; Spline Mesh inclusion already defaults to 1.

entries.name: r.RayTracing.Shadows.EnableTwoSidedGeometry
entries.rationale: Valid, default 1. Disabling can reduce ray-tracing work but makes open/two-sided geometry miss shadow occluders. Hardware-RT/content profile only.

entries.name: r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen hardware-ray-tracing switch, default 0. It requires project and platform support and can have high scene-update cost.

entries.name: r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing.HitLighting.ReflectionCaptures
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen HWRT hit-lighting option, default 0. Reflection-capture lighting at ray hits is renderer-specific and adds quality/cost.

entries.name: r.Lumen.Reflections.HardwareRayTracing
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Lumen reflection control; hardware ray tracing for this path already defaults to 1 when global project/platform support permits it.

entries.name: r.Lumen.Reflections.HardwareRayTracing.HitLighting
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid UE 5.6+ Lumen HWRT option, default 0. It fires a second hit-lighting trace for invalid Surface Cache hits, improving quality at extra cost.

categories.title: MegaLights
categories.summary: MegaLights — UE5's newer lighting system for scenes with many lights; tuning for games that use it.

entries.name: r.MegaLights.AsyncCompute.GenerateSamples
entries.rationale: Valid current MegaLights CVar, disabled by default. Epic requires workload- specific A/B testing; only relevant when MegaLights/async compute are supported.

entries.name: r.MegaLights.AsyncCompute.Volume
entries.rationale: Valid current MegaLights CVar, disabled by default. Benefit depends on graphics versus compute-pipe workload and volumetric passes. A/B test per title/GPU.

entries.name: r.MegaLights.DirectionalLights
entries.rationale: Valid and exact current default. Epic recommends keeping strong directional lights outside MegaLights. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.MegaLights.NumSamplesPerPixel
entries.rationale: Valid primary quality/performance control, but scalability profiles choose it and there is no universal value. Only expose for confirmed MegaLights games.

entries.name: r.MegaLights.Volume.GridPixelSize
entries.rationale: Valid current MegaLights volume-resolution control. Grid density trades GPU cost against lit-translucency and volumetric-fog shadow clarity/stability. Value 16 is not universal; confirmed MegaLights titles only, with A/B testing.

categories.title: Shadows, Fog & Ambient Occlusion
categories.summary: Shadow resolution and memory use, how detailed volumetric fog (light shafts, haze) is, and which method draws the soft contact shadows in corners and crevices.

entries.name: r.DFShadowAsyncCompute
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Can overlap distance-field shadow work where supported, but benefit depends on renderer, GPU queues, and available overlap. A/B test.

entries.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Cache.AllocateViaLRU
entries.rationale: Valid VSM cache policy, default 0. Changes page retention/allocation behavior; scene- and memory-sensitive, so test per title rather than force generally.

entries.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.Cache.StaticSeparate
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default. It can improve static scenes while doubling VSM page-pool memory, but the source value adds nothing. Omit.

entries.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.MaxPhysicalPages
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 4096. Halving the pool saves GPU memory but can exhaust pages and reduce shadow quality. VRAM/title-specific profile only.

entries.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.ResolutionLodBiasDirectional
entries.rationale: Valid, current default -1.5. Value -0.5 lowers directional VSM resolution and cost, with softer/blockier shadows. Explicit shadow-quality profile only.

entries.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.ResolutionLodBiasDirectionalMoving
entries.rationale: Valid, current default -1.5. Same quality/performance tradeoff for moving directional lights; content-specific.

entries.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.SMRT.SamplesPerRayDirectional
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 4. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.SMRT.SamplesPerRayLocal
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 4. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Shadow.Virtual.NonNanite.IncludeInCoarsePages
entries.rationale: Valid, default 1. Disabling can be a significant performance win, but may remove needed coarse shadow data from non-Nanite geometry. Content-specific.

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.GridPixelSize
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 8. Larger cells improve performance but reduce fog resolution/quality. Explicit fog-quality profile only.

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.InjectShadowedLightsSeparately
entries.rationale: Valid and already current default 1. Omit.

entries.name: r.VolumetricFog.Jitter
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1 for temporal supersampling. Omit.

entries.name: r.AmbientOcclusion.Method
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Ambient Occlusion method selector; 0 chooses SSAO while 1 chooses GTAO. Quality, cost and platform support differ.

categories.title: Reflections & Water
categories.summary: Screen-space reflections and water reflection quality.

entries.name: r.SSR.Temporal
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid SSR temporal-filter control. Current table and help/default behavior are inconsistent; it can reduce noise but add ghosting and only affects SSR.

entries.name: r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.DownsampleFactor
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid UE 5.6+ Single Layer Water reflection control; full-resolution downsample factor 1 is already the current default.

entries.name: r.Water.SingleLayer.Reflection.ScreenSpaceReconstruction
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid UE 5.6+ Single Layer Water option, default 0. Screen-space reconstruction is water-path-specific and usually unnecessary for mirror-like reflections.

categories.title: Nanite Detail & Streaming
categories.summary: Nanite — UE5's geometry system; how much detail it keeps and how much memory it uses.

entries.name: landscape.RenderNanite
entries.rationale: Valid exact default. Only acts when Nanite landscape data was authored/built.

entries.name: r.GeometryCollection.Nanite
entries.rationale: Valid and already current default 1. Omit and inherit project/content support.

entries.name: r.Nanite.DicingRate
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Nanite tessellation control; a two-pixel dicing rate is the current default.

entries.name: r.Nanite.MaterialVisibility.Async
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Nanite.MaxPixelsPerEdge
entries.rationale: Valid primary Nanite detail/performance control; current default 1. Raising it reduces geometric detail/work and can expose visual issues. Older UE5 revisions need extra caution. Explicit Nanite performance profile only.

entries.name: r.Nanite.SoftwareVRS
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1. Omit and inherit capability handling.

entries.name: r.Nanite.Streaming.Async
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Nanite already schedules streaming work asynchronously. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Nanite.Streaming.AsyncCompute
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Capability handling is engine/platform controlled. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Nanite.Streaming.NumInitialRootPages
entries.rationale: Source state: commented/inert under [SystemSettings]. Valid Nanite streaming control; 2048 initial root pages is the current default, so leaving it commented is correct.

entries.name: r.Nanite.Streaming.StreamingPoolSize
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid Nanite streaming control; current default is 512 MB. A 768-MB pool may reduce pressure but reserves another 256 MB of GPU memory.

entries.name: wp.Runtime.HLOD.WarmupNanite
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly default 1 when WP HLOD/Nanite applies. Omit.

categories.title: Variable Rate Shading
categories.summary: Variable Rate Shading — renders parts of the screen at lower detail to save GPU time, on hardware that supports it.

entries.name: r.VRS.BasePass
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 2 (conservative). Value 1 selects full VRS for the base pass and can trade image quality for performance. Hardware/title testing needed.

entries.name: r.VRS.ContrastAdaptiveShading
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 0. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.VRS.Enable
entries.rationale: Valid global VRS switch, default false. Requires compatible RHI/hardware and can introduce visible shading-rate artifacts. Platform/profile only.

entries.name: r.VRS.EnableImage
entries.rationale: Valid image-based VRS switch, default false. Requires supported attachment/ hardware and a suitable image generator. Platform/profile only.

entries.name: r.VRS.EnableSoftware
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Generates software shading-rate images for supported Nanite paths; feature/content-specific.

entries.name: r.VRS.LightFunctions
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.VRS.NaniteEmitGBuffer
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 2 (conservative). Value 1 requests full VRS for this pass; hardware/Nanite quality testing required.

entries.name: r.VRS.ReflectionEnvironmentSky
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 2 (conservative). Value 1 is a title/hardware-specific quality/performance tradeoff.

entries.name: r.VRS.SSAO
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 0. Enabling full VRS for SSAO can save work but may create visible artifacts. Test per platform/title.

entries.name: r.VRS.SSR
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 2 (conservative). Value 1 is a quality/performance tradeoff requiring hardware/title testing.

entries.name: r.VRS.Translucency
entries.rationale: Valid pass control and exactly current default 1. Global VRS support/enabling still gates it. Omit and inherit.

categories.title: Effects & Particles
categories.summary: Particle effects (Niagara and older emitter systems) — quality, memory use and how they are processed.

entries.name: FX.AllowAsyncTick
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Enables parallel ticking of legacy particle systems; task overhead and thread safety depend on effects/title.

entries.name: FX.BatchAsync
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Batches small legacy-particle tasks; workload-specific.

entries.name: FX.BatchAsyncBatchSize
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 32 and only relevant with line 747. Task-overhead versus latency tradeoff.

entries.name: FX.EarlyScheduleAsync
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Legacy-particle scheduling/overlap tradeoff.

entries.name: fx.GPUSimulationTextureSizeX
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 1024. Reduces legacy GPU-particle capacity/memory and can truncate effects. Device-profile/content-specific.

entries.name: fx.GPUSimulationTextureSizeY
entries.rationale: Same capacity/quality tradeoff as line 752.

entries.name: fx.NiagaraAllowRuntimeScalabilityChanges
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: fx.NiagaraBatcher.FreeBufferEarly
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 1. Keeping buffers can avoid reallocations for oscillating emitters but retains GPU memory. Niagara-content-specific.

entries.name: fx.NiagaraDataBufferMinSize
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 512 bytes. Larger minimum allocations reduce small-buffer churn but waste memory for light Niagara workloads. Content-specific.

entries.name: fx.ParticlePerfStats.Enabled
entries.rationale: Valid, default true. Can reduce stat gathering but may remove data used by a title's FX budgeting/profiling. Explicit title profile only.

entries.name: fx.ScalabilityManParallelThreshold
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 50. Parallel-task crossover depends on CPU and Niagara instance workload.

entries.name: fx.ScalabilityMaxUpdatesPerFrame
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 50. Throttles scalability processing and can delay culling or state response.

entries.name: r.Emitter.FastPoolEnable
entries.rationale: Valid legacy emitter-pooling control, but current reference text/table disagree about its default. Pooling trades allocations for retained memory; test per game.

entries.name: vm.FreeUnoptimizedByteCode
entries.rationale: Real VectorVM CVar, but 1 is already the stock default. Omit this line to inherit normally; it is not a general shader-compilation tweak.

entries.name: vm.OptimizeVMByteCode
entries.rationale: Real VectorVM/Niagara CVar, but 1 is already the stock default. Omit this line to inherit normally; it is unrelated to general shader compilation.

categories.title: Foliage & Grass
categories.summary: How much grass and foliage appears and how quickly it builds up around you.

entries.name: foliage.DensityScale
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid foliage scalability control; density scale 1 is neutral/default and only affects foliage types authored to permit scaling.

entries.name: grass.densityScale
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid grass scalability control; density scale 1 is neutral/default.

entries.name: grass.MaxAsyncTasks
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 4. More concurrent grass creation can improve throughput or increase CPU contention.

entries.name: grass.MaxCreatePerFrame
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 1. Reduces slow grass buildup/pop-in but can create frame hitches.

categories.title: Textures, Streaming & Sharpness
categories.summary: How textures are streamed into memory and how sharp they look at an angle — texture sharpness, memory use and loading.

entries.name: PoolSizeVRAMPercentage
entries.rationale: Real [TextureStreaming] key. A 60% pool is a hardware/game VRAM policy; fixed percentages can under- or over-allocate depending on other GPU resources.

entries.name: r.MaxAnisotropy
entries.rationale: Current stock CVar; legal range 1-16. Value 16 is a valid maximum-quality choice, but scalability and texture groups can override it. Quality-preset candidate.

entries.name: r.PreTileTextures
entries.rationale: Valid stock cook-time setting and already default 1. A player INI cannot retile cooked textures; omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Streaming.Boost
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly stock default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Streaming.DefragDynamicBounds
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Streaming.FramesForFullUpdate
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 5. More frequent full updates improve responsiveness but increase CPU work. CPU/title-specific tradeoff.

entries.name: r.Streaming.FullyLoadUsedTextures
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly default 0. Omit and retain normal streaming.

entries.name: r.Streaming.HLODStrategy
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar, default 0. Value 2 keeps all HLOD texture mips resident, trading reduced streaming and pop-in for potentially large memory use.

entries.name: r.Streaming.LimitPoolSizeToVRAM
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Can prevent VRAM oversubscription, but may shrink the pool and increase lower mips, churn, or pop-in. Test with each game's pool policy.

entries.name: r.Streaming.ParallelRenderAssetsNumWorkgroups
entries.rationale: Valid, default 2. More groups can reduce waits but add game-thread overhead; there is no universal optimum.

entries.name: r.Streaming.StressTest.ExtraAsyncLatency
entries.rationale: Valid, already default 0, and only affects stress tests. Omit.

entries.name: r.Streaming.UseAsyncRequestsForDDC
entries.rationale: Valid; current table value is 1. The description retains stale default prose, and the setting has little packaged-game relevance. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Streaming.UseBackgroundThreadPool
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1 for mip calculations. Omit.

entries.name: r.Streaming.UseFixedPoolSize
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 0, allowing normal runtime pool behavior. Omit.

entries.name: r.Streaming.UseNewMetrics
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1. Value 0 is legacy compatibility. Omit.

entries.name: r.Streaming.UsePerTextureBias
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1. Omit and inherit budget policy.

entries.name: r.TextureStreaming
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1. Texture streaming is enabled normally; omit.

entries.name: r.VT.ParallelFeedbackTasks
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Uses worker threads for VT feedback, but only VT-enabled titles benefit and scheduling overhead depends on CPU/workload. Test per title.

categories.title: Frame Rate, VSync & Latency
categories.summary: VSync, frame limits and input latency — how frames reach the screen and how fast they get there.

entries.name: r.D3D12.UseAllowTearing
entries.rationale: Valid D3D12 CVar and exactly current default 1. This also contradicts line 15's value 0; the later ConsoleVariables value would win. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.FinishCurrentFrame
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly default 0. Omit; value 1 reduces buffering/latency but harms throughput.

entries.name: t.Streamline.Reflex.Mode
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Not a stock UE5 CVar. It belongs to NVIDIA Streamline/Reflex integration and only disables that plugin when present.

entries.name: r.OneFrameThreadLag
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1. Omit; changing it is a latency/throughput tradeoff.

entries.name: r.VSync
entries.rationale: Real stock CVar and default 0. Disabling VSync is a display/user preference: it can reduce latency but can also tear, increase GPU load, and override the game's own setting. Keep only as an explicit display toggle.

categories.title: Level Streaming & Loading
categories.summary: How levels and areas load and unload around the player, and how much memory loading uses.

entries.name: s.AdaptiveAddToWorld.Enabled
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Replaces a fixed AddToWorld time slice with adaptive budgeting; loading smoothness/latency depends on title and CPU.

entries.name: s.AsyncLoadingTimeLimit
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 5 ms. Lower budget can reduce frame spikes but extends loading. Title/CPU-specific.

entries.name: s.IoDispatcherBufferMemoryMB
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 8 MB. More buffer memory may help I/O throughput but adds fixed RAM use; storage/title-specific.

entries.name: s.IoDispatcherCacheSizeMB
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 0. A fixed 2-GB cache is a very large RAM reservation; only a deliberately profiled high-memory title should consider it.

entries.name: s.IoDispatcherDecompressionWorkerCount
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 4. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: s.MaxIncomingRequestsToStall
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 100. Stalling after a single request can serialize I/O and destroy throughput; not a sensible general policy.

entries.name: s.MaxReadyRequestsToStallMB
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 30 MB. Value 0 removes memory backpressure and can allow unhandled I/O requests to grow dangerously.

entries.name: s.MaxLevelRequestsAtOnceWhileInMatch
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0/unlimited. Capping concurrent level requests can reduce spikes but delay streaming; title-specific.

entries.name: s.ProcessPrestreamingRequests
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Only useful when a cooked title generated and relies on prestreaming requests. Project-specific.

entries.name: s.UseUnifiedTimeBudgetForStreaming
entries.rationale: Valid UE 5.6+ opt-in control. A unified async-loading and level-streaming budget changes frame ordering and latency, so it requires title-specific testing.

entries.name: wp.Runtime.HLOD.WarmupEnabled
entries.rationale: Valid current World Partition CVar and exactly default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: wp.Runtime.HLOD.WarmupVT
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 1. Disabling VT warmup may save work but can expose HLOD virtual-texture pop-in. WP/HLOD/VT titles only.

entries.name: wp.Runtime.LevelStreamingContinuouslyIncrementalGCWhileLevelsPendingPurgeForWP
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 64. Higher threshold delays incremental GC, trading less frequent work for more pending memory. WP/title-specific.

entries.name: wp.Runtime.MaxLoadingStreamingCells
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 4. More concurrent cell loads can improve throughput but spike I/O, CPU, and memory. Open-world/hardware-specific.

entries.name: wp.Runtime.UpdateStreamingStateTimeLimit
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 0. Time-slicing WP state updates can reduce spikes but delay streaming convergence. Profile per open-world title.

categories.title: Shader Compilation & Stutter
categories.summary: Options that pre-compile shaders to reduce hitches and stutter, at the cost of startup time, memory or disk space.

entries.name: r.pso.evictiontime
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 60 seconds. Faster eviction may save memory but can cause more PSO recreation and hitches. Title/memory-specific.

entries.name: r.ShaderPipelineCache.BackgroundBatchSize
entries.rationale: Valid stock cache control, but it overrides the current default of 1. A larger background batch can reduce warm-up time while increasing frame-time pressure.

entries.name: r.ShaderPipelineCache.BatchSize
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 50. Smaller batches can reduce one-frame compilation work but prolong cache warmup. Requires a valid title-supplied PSO cache.

entries.name: r.ShaderPipelineCache.BatchTime
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 16 ms. Omit.

entries.name: r.ShaderPipelineCache.Enabled
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Only useful when the game ships or records a compatible PipelineFileCache; blindly enabling an absent/incomplete cache adds nothing.

entries.name: r.ShaderPipelineCache.GameFileMaskEnabled
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Requires cache recording with usage masks; title-build policy.

entries.name: r.ShaderPipelineCache.PrecompileBatchSize
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 50. Batch tradeoff only matters when pre-optimizing a valid PSO cache; title/platform-specific.

entries.name: r.ShaderPipelineCache.PrecompileBatchTime
entries.rationale: Valid nonzero time budget; current table/help contains legacy default wording. Startup/frame-time tradeoff requiring title profiling.

entries.name: r.ShaderPipelineCache.PreOptimizeEnabled
entries.rationale: Valid current stock PSO-cache control, default 0. Enabling pre-optimization only makes sense when the title supplies a compatible cache and startup flow.

entries.name: r.Shaders.Optimize
entries.rationale: Valid shader-build setting and already default 1. Omit; packaged shaders are already compiled.

entries.name: r.Shaders.RemoveDeadCode
entries.rationale: Valid shader-preprocessing setting and already default 1. Omit.

entries.name: r.SupportAllShaderPermutations
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly default 0/no override. Omit.

entries.name: niagara.CreateShadersOnLoad
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Can reduce first-use Niagara hitches but increases startup time and memory. Niagara/title-specific.

entries.name: D3D12.PSO.DiskCache
entries.rationale: Valid D3D12 PSO cache. Current reference table/help disagree about the default; it can improve later runs but remains D3D12/title cache policy. Test per game.

entries.name: D3D12.PSO.DriverOptimizedDiskCache
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Machine/driver-specific cache may improve subsequent PSO creation but needs invalidation/storage testing.

entries.name: r.PSOPrecaching
entries.rationale: Added by the maintainer, not by the audit. Master switch for runtime PSO precaching: the engine builds pipeline state objects ahead of the draw that needs them, from the materials and components in the level.

entries.name: r.PSOPrecache.Components
entries.rationale: Added by the maintainer, not by the audit. Precaches pipeline state objects for primitive components as they are registered into the world.

entries.name: r.PSOPrecache.Resources
entries.rationale: Added by the maintainer, not by the audit. Precaches pipeline state objects for resource-driven draws such as decals and hair.

entries.name: r.PSOPrecache.GlobalShaders
entries.rationale: Added by the maintainer, not by the audit. Precaches pipeline state objects for the engine's own global shaders rather than only for material shaders.

entries.name: r.PSOPrecache.ProxyCreationWhenPSOReady
entries.rationale: Added by the maintainer, not by the audit. Delays creating a render proxy until its precached pipeline state objects are ready, so the draw waits instead of stalling the frame to compile.

entries.name: r.PSOPrecache.ProxyCreationDelayStrategy
entries.rationale: Added by the maintainer, not by the audit. Chooses what to show while a proxy is delayed: 0 skips the draw entirely, 1 draws with the default material until the real one is ready.

entries.name: r.PSOPrecache.WaitForHighPriorityRequestsOnly
entries.rationale: Added by the maintainer, not by the audit. When 1, only high-priority precache requests are waited on and the rest are allowed to compile late.

entries.name: r.PSOPrecache.Validation
entries.rationale: Added by the maintainer, not by the audit. Developer check that counts pipeline state objects missed by precaching. It costs time and reports nothing a player can act on.

categories.title: Occlusion & Culling
categories.summary: Occlusion culling — skipping work for objects hidden behind others; more aggressive culling can save CPU but may show late pop-in.

entries.name: D3D12.InsertOuterOcclusionQuery
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Epic notes it can help some GPU architectures; benefit is hardware-specific and must be measured.

entries.name: foliage.MaxOcclusionQueriesPerComponent
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 16. Aggressive foliage occlusion granularity; content/ CPU/GPU-specific.

entries.name: foliage.MinOcclusionQueriesPerComponent
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 6. Same content-dependent foliage occlusion tradeoff.

entries.name: r.InstanceCulling.OcclusionCull
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Can reduce instance work but is renderer/content dependent and may alter visibility behavior. Test per title.

entries.name: r.NumBufferedOcclusionQueries
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 1. More buffering can reduce CPU waits but increases stale occlusion results/artifacts. Renderer/title-specific.

entries.name: r.Visibility.TaskSchedule
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 1 async task-graph scheduling. Forcing 0 shifts work back toward the render thread and has no universal benefit.

entries.name: r.Visibility.FrustumCull.UseSphereTestFirst
entries.rationale: Valid, default false. Adds a sphere test before the box test; whether it saves CPU work depends on scene bounds and rejection rates. Profile per title.

categories.title: GPU Memory Management
categories.summary: How graphics memory (VRAM) is organised, defragmented and reused — advanced internals, safe to leave on.

entries.name: D3D12.AllowPoolAllocateIndirectArgBuffers
entries.rationale: Valid D3D12 option, current default 0. Pool allocation can change memory/API behavior; hardware/workload-specific and requires testing.

entries.name: D3D12.ResidencyManagement
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default/on. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: D3D12.VRAMBufferPoolDefrag
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1. Omit.

entries.name: D3D12.VRAMBufferPoolDefrag.MaxCopySizePerFrame
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 32 MB; source caps at 16 MB. Lower copy budget may reduce one-frame cost but slows defrag. Hardware/memory-pressure-specific.

entries.name: D3D12.VRAMTexturePoolDefrag
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1. Omit.

entries.name: D3D12.VRAMTexturePoolDefrag.MaxCopySizePerFrame
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 32 MB; source caps at 16 MB. Same frame-cost versus defrag-progress tradeoff as line 396.

entries.name: D3D12.ZeroBufferSizeInMB
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 4 MB. More memory supports unusually large async-streamed mips but wastes a fixed allocation for ordinary titles. Content-specific.

entries.name: r.GPUDefrag.AllowOverlappedMoves
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Omit.

entries.name: r.GPUDefrag.EnableTimeLimits
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Omit.

entries.name: r.GPUDefrag.MaxRelocations
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar; 10 is exactly the documented default. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.UniformBufferPooling
entries.rationale: Valid and already default optimization. Omit.

categories.title: Threading & Parallelism
categories.summary: How much work the engine spreads across CPU cores — advanced internals, safe to leave on.

entries.name: r.AOAsyncBuildQueue
entries.rationale: Current stock CVar; 1 is the documented default for asynchronous mesh distance-field volume-data building. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.AsyncCreateLightPrimitiveInteractions
entries.rationale: Current stock CVar; 1 is already default. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.AsyncPipelineCompile
entries.rationale: Current stock CVar; 1 is already the default asynchronous PSO behavior. Omit.

entries.name: r.MeshDrawCommands.ParallelPassSetup
entries.rationale: Valid stock renderer CVar and already default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.ParallelBasePass
entries.rationale: Valid stock renderer CVar and already default 1. Omit and inherit; it only has effect when parallel rendering is supported.

entries.name: r.ParallelPrePass
entries.rationale: Exact stock renderer CVar and already default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.ParallelTranslucency
entries.rationale: Exact stock renderer CVar and already default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.ParallelVelocity
entries.rationale: Exact stock renderer CVar and already default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.RDG.AsyncCompute
entries.rationale: Valid stock RDG policy and already default 1 for tagged passes. Omit and inherit engine/platform scheduling.

entries.name: r.RDG.ParallelExecute
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar; 1 is already default and enables parallel pass execution when supported. Omit and inherit engine/platform capability handling.

entries.name: r.RHICmdUseParallelAlgorithms
entries.rationale: Valid stock rendering control; 1 is already default. Omit and let platform/ engine policy manage frontend parallelization.

entries.name: r.StochasticLighting.AsyncCompute
entries.rationale: Valid current control and already default 1. It automatically follows relevant downstream async work, which is the intended engine-managed behavior. Omit.

entries.name: tick.AllowAsyncTickDispatch
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar, default 0. Dispatching ticks from a task thread can reduce game-thread work but needs per-title correctness and profiling.

entries.name: tick.AllowBatchedTicks
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar, default 0. Automatic tick batching can reduce task overhead, but Epic notes that the benefit depends on the game's exact tick workload.

entries.name: D3D12.MaxCommandsPerCommandList
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 10000. Larger lists reduce flush frequency but can affect latency, memory, and driver scheduling. Hardware/workload-specific.

entries.name: RHI.ResourceTableCaching
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar (canonical rhi.ResourceTableCaching); names are case- insensitive. Value 1 is already default. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: RHI.SyncAllowEarlyKick
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar (canonical rhi.SyncAllowEarlyKick), already default 1. It only applies on supported RHI/VSync pacing paths. Omit and inherit platform policy.

categories.title: Physics
categories.summary: Chaos — the physics system; internal optimisations, safe to leave on.

entries.name: p.Chaos.PerParticleCollision.ISPC
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default true. Omit and inherit build/platform policy.

entries.name: p.Chaos.Spherical.ISPC
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default true. Omit.

entries.name: p.Chaos.Spring.ISPC
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default true. Omit.

entries.name: p.Chaos.TriangleMesh.ISPC
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default true. Omit.

entries.name: p.Chaos.VelocityField.ISPC
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default true. Omit.

categories.title: Garbage Collection
categories.summary: How the engine frees unused memory — internal, safe to leave on.

entries.name: gc.AllowParallelGC
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Omit.

entries.name: gc.CreateGCClusters
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Omit and inherit project behavior.

entries.name: gc.MultithreadedDestructionEnabled
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Omit.

entries.name: s.ForceGCAfterLevelStreamedOut
entries.rationale: Added by the maintainer, not by the audit. Stock CVar, default 1: the engine forces a full collection every time a level streams out. 0 lets the normal purge schedule handle it, trading held memory for fewer unload hitches.

categories.title: Animation
categories.summary: How character, object and recorded-mesh animation is processed — internal, safe to leave on.

entries.name: a.ParallelAnimEvaluation
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar and exactly default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: a.ParallelAnimInterpolation
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar and exactly default 1. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: a.ParallelAnimUpdate
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar and exactly default 1. Worker eligibility still requires safe project/Animation Blueprint configuration. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: GeometryCache.OffloadUpdate
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Only titles using Geometry Cache benefit, and platform behavior must be tested.

categories.title: Audio
categories.summary: How audio processing is scheduled to avoid stutter and crackle.

entries.name: au.DisableParallelSourceProcessing
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 1. Value 0 enables async source processing; benefit depends on source count, CPU scheduling, backend, and platform.

entries.name: AudioThread.AboveNormalPriority
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. May reduce audio underruns but steals CPU scheduling priority from other work. Hardware/title-specific.

entries.name: AudioThread.BatchAsyncBatchSize
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 128. Larger batches trade command throughput against latency; no universal optimum.

entries.name: AudioThread.EnableBatchProcessing
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly current default 1. Omit.

categories.title: HDR
categories.summary: HDR — brighter highlights and wider colour range on an HDR-capable display.

entries.name: r.HDR.EnableHDROutput
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock HDR-output switch, default 0. It requires compatible display, OS, RHI, output-device and gamut handling, so expose it only as an explicit display choice.

categories.title: Power & Battery
categories.summary: Whether the game limits itself to save battery on laptops.

entries.name: r.DontLimitOnBattery
entries.rationale: Valid, default 0. Explicit user preference: more performance on battery versus battery life, heat, and noise. Never force universally.

categories.title: Crash Reporting & Diagnostics
categories.summary: Crash reporting (privacy choice) and GPU debugging data — the debugging options are safe to leave off.

entries.name: bAgreeToCrashUpload
entries.rationale: Real CrashReportClient privacy control. On Windows/macOS it already defaults false; Linux defaults true. Retain only as an explicit user privacy choice, not a performance preset.

entries.name: r.D3D12.DRED
entries.rationale: Valid D3D12 crash-debug option and exactly default 0. Omit.

entries.name: r.ForceDebugViewModes
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly default 0/no override. Omit.

entries.name: r.GPUCrashDebugging
entries.rationale: Valid vendor crash-analysis master option; 0 is stock default. Omit. Diagnostic features should be enabled deliberately when investigating a crash.

entries.name: r.GPUCrashDebugging.Aftermath.Callstack
entries.rationale: Valid NVIDIA Aftermath option; 0 is the stock default. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.GPUCrashDebugging.Aftermath.Markers
entries.rationale: Valid NVIDIA Aftermath option; 0 is the stock default. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.GPUCrashDump
entries.rationale: Valid vendor crash-dump option; 0 is stock default. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.RHICmdBypass
entries.rationale: Valid stock debugging CVar; 0 is already default and leaves the multithreaded renderer active. Value 1 is a low-level debugging bypass. Omit.

entries.name: r.D3D12.GPUTimeout
entries.rationale: Real D3D12 CVar, but stock default is 1. Epic explicitly warns that 0 can freeze the PC; Windows timeout recovery exists to restore responsiveness.

entries.name: r.D3D12.LightweightDRED
entries.rationale: Valid, current default 1. Disabling basic crash diagnostics is not a universal performance improvement and makes GPU failures harder to diagnose.

entries.name: r.GPUCrash.Collectionenable
entries.rationale: Real case-insensitive CVar (canonical lowercase), default 1. Value 0 disables useful scoped-event crash data without a defensible universal performance gain.

entries.name: r.GPUCrash.DataDepth
entries.rationale: Real case-insensitive CVar, default -1. Value 0 truncates crash-marker depth and harms diagnostics; it is not performance tuning.

categories.title: Other
categories.summary: Low-level rendering internals — detail level, sky, skin and transparent-object handling; safe to leave on.

entries.name: r.DetailMode
entries.rationale: Source state: active under [SystemSettings]. Valid stock detail-mode control; 3 is the current Epic/default level and shows all eligible components.

entries.name: r.MeshDrawCommands.DynamicInstancing
entries.rationale: Valid and already default 1 on compatible vertex factories. Omit.

entries.name: r.SkyAtmosphere.AerialPerspectiveLUT.FastApplyOnOpaque
entries.rationale: Valid and already current default 1. It is the faster path, with known possible high-frequency atmospheric artifacts. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.SkyLight.RealTimeReflectionCapture.TimeSlice
entries.rationale: Valid stock CVar; 1 is the documented default, so real-time Sky Light capture already uses time slicing.

entries.name: r.SSS.Burley.EnableProfileIdCache
entries.rationale: Valid and exactly default 1. Uses one byte per pixel to accelerate Burley SSS. Omit and inherit.

entries.name: r.Translucency.AutoBeforeDOF
entries.rationale: Valid experimental control, current default 0.5. It changes where translucency is binned relative to depth of field; visual/content-specific.

entries.name: Slate.bAllowThrottling
entries.rationale: Valid stock editor/Slate policy, default 1. Setting 0 disables UI throttling and is not a general packaged-game optimization.

presets.title: Quality
presets.description: Favours image quality. Assumes headroom on the GPU and a display worth feeding.

presets.title: Recommended
presets.description: What most people should use. Every catalog entry's base value belongs to this preset; the others are expressed as overrides on top of it. The id stays 'balanced' because it is written into the file and into saved settings.

presets.title: Performance
presets.description: Favours frame rate and frame pacing. Drops the effects that cost the most for the least visible gain.

options.title: Adaptive sync monitor
options.summary: Leave this on for a G-Sync or FreeSync monitor. Turn it off only if your monitor has neither.

options.title: Force HDR output
options.summary: Turn this on if you have an HDR display and the game offers no HDR setting of its own.

options.title: Reduce motion blur
options.summary: Turn this on if motion blur makes you feel unwell, or makes fast movement hard to follow.

options.title: Extra sharpening
options.summary: Turn this on if the picture looks soft and you want edges to stand out more.

options.title: Lowest input lag
options.summary: Turn this on if lower delay matters more to you than maximum overall performance.

options.title: Laptop on battery
options.summary: Turn this on if you play on a laptop and want full speed while unplugged. The battery drains faster and the machine runs hotter.

options.title: Fix crackling sound
options.summary: Turn this on if you hear the sound crackle, pop or drop out.

options.title: I have a weaker PC
options.summary: Turn this on if your PC has little memory to spare. Textures may look softer, but the game is less likely to run out.

options.title: Anti-aliasing method
options.summary: Leave this alone if the game has its own anti-aliasing setting, or if you use DLSS or FSR. Pick one only if the game gives you no choice.

options.title: Turn off depth of field
options.summary: Turn this on if blurred backgrounds bother you or make text hard to read. Some games blur on purpose to show you where to look, so it can change how a scene reads.

options.title: Turn off film grain and colour fringing
options.summary: Turn this on if the picture looks grainy, or if colours split into red and blue towards the edges of the screen.

options.title: Lumen: cheaper probe blending
options.summary: Blends Lumen probes from one sample instead of four. It may gain a little speed. Indirect light can look noisier and less steady.

options.title: Lumen: smooth probes over time
options.summary: Averages Lumen probes across frames. Indirect light is less noisy. Light can lag behind movement and leave faint trails.

options.title: Lumen: cache distant reflections
options.summary: Reuses cached distant lighting for rough reflections instead of tracing them. It may gain speed. Epic marks this one experimental.

options.title: MegaLights: use the async compute queue
options.summary: Runs MegaLights sampling and volume work alongside the rest of the frame instead of in line. Epic asks for a test rather than giving an answer, because the gain depends on your GPU and the scene. Leave it on Preset decides unless you are measuring.

options.title: Distance field shadows: use the async compute queue
options.summary: Runs distance field shadow work alongside the rest of the frame instead of in line. Epic asks for a test rather than giving an answer, because the gain depends on your GPU. Off writes the engine's own value.

options.title: Shadow cache: evict the least recently used page
options.summary: Changes which shadow map pages the cache throws away first. It may help a scene that keeps revisiting the same views and hurt one that does not. Off writes the engine's own value.

options.title: Ambient occlusion method
options.summary: The soft darkening where surfaces meet. Leave this alone unless corners look wrong to you. GTAO is usually cleaner and SSAO is the older method; which one performs better depends on your GPU.

options.title: Turn off NVIDIA Reflex
options.summary: Turn this on if the game stutters or the frame timing feels uneven on an NVIDIA card. Reflex lowers input delay, but in some games it disturbs frame pacing and the game gives you no way to switch it off.

options.title: Shader stutter: build draw recipes early
options.summary: Builds the GPU recipes for a scene before the game needs them, so a first-time effect does not stall the frame. An object can appear a moment late or plain grey while it waits. Untested here: switch it on only if you are measuring.
